ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a table of “Energy consumption situation of four countries in 2007”; the rows are countries ①, ②, ③, and ④; the columns include total energy consumption, energy consumption per unit GDP, and “energy consumption composition (%)”. Among them, energy consumption composition is divided into coal, petroleum, natural gas, hydropower, and nuclear power. The three items related to the “mineral energy” mentioned in the question are coal, petroleum, and natural gas. The readings in the table are: country ① coal 69.6%, petroleum 21.5%, natural gas 2.2%; country ② coal 24.9%, petroleum 39.7%, natural gas 25.7%; country ③ coal 17.7%, petroleum 51.1%, natural gas 12.5%; country ④ coal 17.3%, petroleum 20.6%, natural gas 55.3%. Then reason: The question requires that the mineral energy consumption composition be relatively balanced, and that the energy with the largest consumption be petroleum. In country ①, the proportion of coal is far higher than petroleum and natural gas, and the structure is not balanced; in country ②, coal 24.9%, petroleum 39.7%, and natural gas 25.7% are relatively close, and petroleum has the largest proportion; in country ③, although petroleum is the largest, petroleum 51.1% is clearly higher than coal and natural gas, so it is not balanced enough; in country ④, natural gas 55.3% is the largest, which does not meet “the largest is petroleum”. Therefore country ② should be selected.

raw_record.question_text:
The following table shows the energy consumption situation of four countries in 2007. Read the table and answer:

<image1>

According to the data in the table, which country has a relatively balanced mineral energy consumption composition, and the energy with the largest consumption is petroleum?

method.method_draft: First describe the table structure and extract the coal, oil, and natural-gas percentages for each country. For each row, check whether the three mineral-energy shares are relatively close and whether the oil percentage is the largest among coal, oil, and gas. ① is dominated by coal, ③ has oil largest but oil is much higher than gas and coal, and ④ is dominated by natural gas. ② has coal 24.9%, oil 39.7%, and natural gas 25.7%, which are comparatively balanced, and oil is the largest. Therefore select ②国.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一张“四个国家2007年能源消费情况”表，行是①、②、③、④四国；列包括能源消费总量、单位GDP能耗，以及“能源消费构成（%）”。其中能源消费构成分为煤炭、石油、天然气、水电和核电。与题目所说“矿物能源”相关的三项是煤炭、石油、天然气。表中读数为：①国煤炭69.6%、石油21.5%、天然气2.2%；②国煤炭24.9%、石油39.7%、天然气25.7%；③国煤炭17.7%、石油51.1%、天然气12.5%；④国煤炭17.3%、石油20.6%、天然气55.3%。再推理：题目要求矿物能源消费构成较均衡，并且消费量最大的能源是石油。①国煤炭占比远高于石油和天然气，结构不均衡；②国煤炭24.9%、石油39.7%、天然气25.7%，三者相对接近，且石油占比最大；③国虽石油最大，但石油51.1%明显高于煤炭和天然气，不够均衡；④国天然气55.3%最大，不符合“最大的是石油”。因此应选②国。
